test_cases.title: Start of Mission tetikleyicisi ile iletişim oturumu başlatma
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Start of Mission durumuna geçiş yapmaya hazırdır. RBC iletişim bilgileri saklanmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Start of Mission komutu.

steps.action: Sürücü Start of Mission işlemini başlatır.
steps.expected: OBU, SUBSET-026 §3.5.3.4'te tanımlanan tetikleyici durumuna göre bir iletişim oturumu başlatma sürecini başlatır.

test_cases.title: Ray kenarı komutu ile iletişim oturumu başlatma
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, ray kenarı ile iletişim halindedir. Geçerli bir RBC kimliği mevcuttur.
test_cases.test_inputs: Ray kenarından gelen 'İletişim oturumu başlat' komutu.

steps.action: Ray kenarından geçerli bir RBC kimliği içeren iletişim oturumu başlatma komutu gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, bu tetikleyici durumuna yanıt olarak bir iletişim oturumu başlatma sürecini başlatır.

test_cases.title: Güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu ve oturum başlatma sıralaması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, iletişim oturumu başlatma tetikleyicisi almıştır. Radyo sistemi hazırdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen uyumlu sistem sürümü bilgisi.

steps.action: OBU, güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu için istek gönderir.
steps.expected: Güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulur.

steps.action: OBU, 'Initiation of communication session' mesajını gönderir.
steps.expected: RBC, sistem sürümü bilgisini gönderir.

steps.action: OBU, gelen sistem sürümünün uyumlu olduğunu doğrular.
steps.expected: Oturum kurulmuş olarak kabul edilir ve 'session established report' mesajı gönderilir.

test_cases.title: Uyumlu olmayan sistem sürümü durumunda oturum sonlandırma
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, iletişim oturumu başlatma tetikleyicisi almıştır. Radyo sistemi hazırdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen uyumsuz sistem sürümü bilgisi.

steps.action: OBU, güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu için istek gönderir ve 'Initiation of communication session' mesajını iletir.
steps.expected: RBC, uyumsuz bir sistem sürümü bilgisini gönderir.

steps.action: OBU, gelen sistem sürümünün uyumsuz olduğunu tespit eder.
steps.expected: OBU, 'No compatible version supported' mesajını gönderir, sürücüye bilgi verir ve oturumu sonlandırır.

test_cases.title: Güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumunda öncelik sırasının uygulanması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da hem GSM-R hem de FRMCS radyo sistemleri mevcuttur. Ray kenarı komutu, FRMCS-only bir RBC'ye yönelik değildir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Start of Mission sırasında sürücünün tek radyo seçimi: GSM-R. Saklanan Radio Network bilgisi: FRMCS tercihli.

steps.action: Start of Mission tetikleyicisi ile iletişim oturumu başlatma süreci başlatılır.
steps.expected: OBU, öncelik sırasına göre (ray kenarı komutu yoksa, sürücü seçimi) GSM-R radyo sistemini kullanarak güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu için istek gönderir.

test_cases.title: Başarılı radyo sisteminin hafızaya kaydedilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da hem GSM-R hem de FRMCS radyo sistemleri mevcuttur. Önceki oturumda FRMCS kullanılmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yeni bir iletişim oturumu başlatma tetikleyicisi.

steps.action: OBU, GSM-R radyo sistemini kullanarak güvenli radyo bağlantısını başarıyla kurar ve oturumu başlatır.
steps.expected: OBU, başarılı kurulumda kullanılan radyo sistemini (GSM-R) hafızasına kaydeder.

test_cases.title: Oturum kurulumu sırasında End of Mission ile iptal
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu için istek göndermiş ve sistem sürümünü henüz almamıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: End of Mission komutu.

steps.action: Oturum kurulumu devam ederken End of Mission komutu verilir.
steps.expected: OBU, oturum kurulumunu iptal eder ve kurulu olan güvenli radyo bağlantısını serbest bırakır.

test_cases.title: Son bilinen RBC kimliği ile ray kenarı komutunun işlenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da geçerli RBC iletişim bilgileri saklanmıştır. Ray kenarı, 'son bilinen RBC' özel kimlik değerini içeren bir komut gönderir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Ray kenarı komutu: Özel RBC kimliği = 'son bilinen RBC', Telefon numarası = 123456789.

steps.action: Ray kenarı, 'son bilinen RBC' özel kimlik değerini içeren iletişim oturumu başlatma komutu gönderir.
steps.expected: OBU, komuttaki telefon numarasını (123456789) yok sayar ve saklanan RBC iletişim bilgilerini kullanarak RBC'ye bağılır.

test_cases.title: Saklanan RBC bilgisi yokken 'son bilinen RBC' komutunun yok sayılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da saklanan RBC iletişim bilgisi yoktur. Ray kenarı, 'son bilinen RBC' özel kimlik değerini içeren bir komut gönderir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Ray kenarı komutu: Özel RBC kimliği = 'son bilinen RBC'.

steps.action: Ray kenarı, 'son bilinen RBC' özel kimlik değerini içeren iletişim oturumu başlatma komutu gönderir.
steps.expected: OBU, bu komutu yok sayar ve iletişim oturumu başlatma işlemi gerçekleştirmez.

test_cases.title: Prevention of duplicate session establishment with same RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. A communication session with RBC-A is currently being established (state: Establishing).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger for Start of Mission in Level 2.
test_cases.assumptions: RBC-A is the target RBC for the Start of Mission.

steps.action: Initiate Start of Mission in Level 2 targeting RBC-A while the session with RBC-A is still in the 'Establishing' state.
steps.expected: The OBU does not initiate a new communication session setup procedure with RBC-A. The existing establishment process continues or fails according to standard timeout, but no parallel session request is sent.

test_cases.title: Prevention of duplicate session establishment after established session without termination
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has an established communication session with RBC-A. No 'Termination of Communication Session' message has been sent to RBC-A.
test_cases.test_inputs: Driver manually selects RBC-A contact information outside Start of Mission.
test_cases.assumptions: The manual selection targets the same RBC-A with which the session is already active.

steps.action: Driver manually selects RBC-A contact information while the session with RBC-A is active and not terminated.
steps.expected: The OBU does not attempt to open a further communication session with RBC-A. The existing session remains active.

test_cases.title: Termination of existing sessions when establishing new session with different RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has an established communication session with RBC-A. OBU is capable of handling multiple sessions (or the exception condition is not met).
test_cases.test_inputs: Order to establish a session with RBC-B (different from RBC-A).
test_cases.assumptions: RBC-B is a different RBC than RBC-A.

steps.action: Receive an order to establish a communication session with RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a 'Termination of Communication Session' message to RBC-A.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's action towards RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the establishment of a new communication session with RBC-B.

test_cases.title: Exception: RBC transition order with Accepting RBC does not terminate current session
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has an established communication session with RBC-A (currently supervising). OBU can handle multiple communication sessions through GSM-R.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC transition order containing an embedded order to establish a session with Accepting RBC-B.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is capable of maintaining two simultaneous sessions.

steps.action: Receive an RBC transition order that includes an instruction to establish a session with Accepting RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU does NOT send a 'Termination of Communication Session' message to RBC-A.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's action towards RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the establishment of a new communication session with RBC-B while keeping the session with RBC-A active.

test_cases.title: Immediate reconnection attempt upon safe radio connection loss
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has an established safe radio connection with the radio system (e.g., GSM-R) and an active communication session.
test_cases.test_inputs: EURORADIO reports loss of safe radio connection.
test_cases.assumptions: The radio system previously used for successful connection is available for reconnection.

steps.action: Simulate EURORADIO reporting that the safe radio connection is lost.
steps.expected: The OBU immediately attempts to set up a new safe radio connection through the same radio system previously used.

test_cases.title: Repeated reconnection attempts until success or termination condition
test_cases.preconditions: Safe radio connection is lost during an established communication session. The session is not yet regarded as terminated.
test_cases.test_inputs: Radio system remains unavailable for a short period, then becomes available.
test_cases.assumptions: The train has not passed the location given in an RIU order to terminate the session.

steps.action: Allow the first reconnection attempt to fail due to radio unavailability.
steps.expected: The OBU keeps repeating the attempt to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Make the radio system available.
steps.expected: The OBU successfully establishes a new safe radio connection and stops repeating the attempt.

test_cases.title: Evaluation of balise information validity in Sleeping mode
test_cases.preconditions: Engine is in Sleeping (SL) mode. Train orientation is Forward.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group crossed in Reverse direction containing information valid for Reverse direction only.
test_cases.assumptions: The referenced balise group is crossed in the reverse direction relative to the train's nominal orientation.

steps.action: Cross a balise group in the reverse direction while in SL mode. The balise contains information valid only for the reverse direction.
steps.expected: The OBU takes into account the information (evaluates it as valid) because it matches the crossing direction.

test_cases.title: Ignoring balise information valid for opposite direction in Shunting mode
test_cases.preconditions: Engine is in Shunting (SH) mode. Train orientation is Forward.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group crossed in Forward direction containing information valid for Reverse direction only.
test_cases.assumptions: The referenced balise group is crossed in the forward direction.

steps.action: Cross a balise group in the forward direction while in SH mode. The balise contains information valid only for the reverse direction.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the information because it is valid only for the opposite direction to the crossing direction.

test_cases.title: MA request parameters persistence and immediate request on parameter update
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has received MA request parameters from RBC: repetition period = 10s, MA requests enabled. Time since last MA request is 12s.
test_cases.test_inputs: New MA request parameters received from RBC: repetition period = 5s.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is in a state where MA requests are applicable.

steps.action: Receive new MA request parameters from the RBC specifying a repetition period of 5s.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces the old parameters with the new ones immediately.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's action immediately after receiving the new parameters.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an MA request immediately because the time since the last MA request (12s) is higher than the newly received repetition period (5s).

test_cases.title: No Supervised Location defined while supervising Limit of Authority
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is supervising a Limit of Authority (LoA) with a target speed above zero. There are potential SvL candidates (e.g., Danger Point) within the LoA.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train moves within the Limit of Authority.
test_cases.assumptions: The LoA is active and being supervised.

steps.action: Move the train within the Limit of Authority where SvL candidates (like Danger Point) exist.
steps.expected: The OBU does not define any Supervised Location (SvL) on board. None of the SvL candidates are used as SvL.

test_cases.title: Level 1 speed restriction remains valid until Level 2 MA accepted
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1 mode with a valid signalling related speed restriction (e.g., 80 km/h).
test_cases.test_inputs: Switch to Level 2 mode. Receive and accept a Level 2 MA.
test_cases.assumptions: The Level 2 MA does not contain a new signalling related speed restriction that overrides the Level 1 one immediately, or the test focuses on the transition period.

steps.action: Switch the OBU from Level 1 to Level 2 mode.
steps.expected: The Level 1 signalling related speed restriction remains valid.

steps.action: Accept a Level 2 Movement Authority (MA).
steps.expected: The Level 1 signalling related speed restriction is no longer applied (replaced by Level 2 logic/MA constraints).

test_cases.title: Maximum Train Speed defined as Static Speed Restriction
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is configured with a specific train performance profile.
test_cases.test_inputs: Set Maximum Train Speed to 200 km/h.
test_cases.assumptions: The train's actual performance allows 200 km/h.

steps.action: Define the Maximum Train Speed as 200 km/h in the OBU configuration.
steps.expected: The OBU handles this value as the Maximum Train Speed category of Static Speed Restriction.

steps.action: Check the speed restriction logic.
steps.expected: The train speed is constrained by this 200 km/h limit as a static restriction.

test_cases.title: Initial state of speed restrictions is 'no speed restriction'
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and in a state where no trackside data has been received yet.
test_cases.test_inputs: None (initial state check).
test_cases.assumptions: No trackside speed restriction data has been received.

steps.action: Check the OBU's speed restriction state before any trackside data is received.
steps.expected: The OBU uses 'no speed restriction' as the initial state. No permitted-braking-distance limit constrains the train speed.

test_cases.title: Resumption of initial state upon trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has an active speed restriction computed from trackside data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside order to resume initial state.
test_cases.assumptions: The trackside sends a specific command to clear/resume the initial state.

steps.action: Receive a trackside order to resume the initial state for speed restrictions.
steps.expected: The OBU clears the current speed restriction and returns to the 'no speed restriction' state.

steps.action: Check the speed constraint.
steps.expected: No permitted-braking-distance limit constrains the train speed.

test_cases.title: OBU initiates session termination upon trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session is established between the OBU and the trackside (RBC).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside sends a 'Termination of Communication Session' order.

steps.action: Send a 'Termination of Communication Session' order from the trackside to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the termination of the communication session.

test_cases.title: OBU does not initiate session termination without trackside order or defined condition
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session is established. No termination conditions from SUBSET-026 are fulfilled.
test_cases.test_inputs: No trackside order is sent. No internal termination condition is triggered.

steps.action: Wait for a duration longer than the fixed waiting time without sending any trackside order or triggering internal conditions.
steps.expected: The OBU does not initiate the termination of the communication session.

test_cases.title: OBU repeats Termination message if no acknowledgement is received
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has initiated the termination of a communication session and sent the 'Termination of Communication Session' message.
test_cases.test_inputs: No acknowledgement is received from the trackside within the fixed waiting time.
test_cases.assumptions: The fixed waiting time is defined in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.1.

steps.action: Wait for the fixed waiting time after the first 'Termination of Communication Session' message without receiving an acknowledgement.
steps.expected: The OBU repeats the 'Termination of Communication Session' message.

test_cases.title: OBU considers session terminated after maximum repetitions without acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in the process of terminating a session and has been repeating the 'Termination of Communication Session' message.
test_cases.test_inputs: No acknowledgement is received after the last allowed repetition.
test_cases.assumptions: The defined number of repetitions is as per SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.1.

steps.action: Allow the OBU to repeat the 'Termination of Communication Session' message the defined number of times without receiving any acknowledgement.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the communication session terminated.

test_cases.title: OBU orders GSM-R registration at power-up
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is powered off. A GSM-R Mobile Terminal is connected.
test_cases.test_inputs: Power-up command.

steps.action: Power up the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU orders the registration of the connected GSM-R Mobile Terminal to a GSM-R Radio Network.

test_cases.title: OBU orders GSM-R registration after driver enters new network identity
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is powered on and a GSM-R Mobile Terminal is connected.
test_cases.test_inputs: Driver enters a new GSM-R Radio Network identity.

steps.action: Driver enters a new GSM-R Radio Network identity into the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU orders the registration of the connected GSM-R Mobile Terminal to the new GSM-R Radio Network.

test_cases.title: OBU orders GSM-R registration upon trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is powered on and a GSM-R Mobile Terminal is connected.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside sends an order to register the GSM-R Mobile Terminal.

steps.action: Send a trackside order to register the GSM-R Mobile Terminal.
steps.expected: The OBU orders the registration of the connected GSM-R Mobile Terminal to a GSM-R Radio Network.

test_cases.title: OBU uses default Radio Network type when no memorised type exists
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has no memorised Radio Network type (e.g., after a System Failure or first power-up).
test_cases.test_inputs: No Radio Network type is received from trackside or entered by the driver.
test_cases.assumptions: A default Radio Network type is configured on-board.

steps.action: Initiate a process that requires a Radio Network type without providing one from trackside or driver.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the default Radio Network type configured on-board.

test_cases.title: OBU does not request safe radio connection if required radio system is not registered
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has a stored Radio Network type. The required radio system for the RBC session is not registered to its Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside sends an order to establish a session with an RBC.
test_cases.assumptions: The radio systems fitted and driver's single-radio choice are such that the required radio system is not registered.

steps.action: Send a trackside order to establish a session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does not request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: OBU does not request safe radio connection for RIU if GSM-R is not registered
test_cases.preconditions: No GSM-R Mobile Terminal is duly registered to a GSM-R Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside sends an order to establish a communication session with an RIU.

steps.action: Send a trackside order to establish a communication session with an RIU.
steps.expected: The OBU does not request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: Güvenli radyo bağlantısı durumlarının sürücüye gösterilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU sürücü arayüzü aktif ve görülebilir durumda.
test_cases.test_inputs: Radyo bağlantısı simülasyonu: Önce 'No Connection' durumu, ardından 'Connection Up' durumu.
test_cases.assumptions: Sürücü arayüzünde radyo bağlantısı durumu göstergesi mevcut.

steps.action: Radyo bağlantısı kurulmamış durumda OBU sürücü arayüzü incelenir.
steps.expected: Göstergede 'No Connection' durumu görünür.

steps.action: Radyo bağlantısı başarıyla kurulur.
steps.expected: Göstergede 'Connection Up' durumu görünür.

test_cases.title: Bağlantı kaybı durumunda göstergenin güncellenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU ile RBC/RIU arasında güvenli radyo bağlantısı 'Connection Up' durumunda.
test_cases.test_inputs: Radyo sinyali kesilir veya bozulur.

steps.action: Aktif radyo bağlantısı kesilir.
steps.expected: Göstergede 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' durumu görünür.

test_cases.title: İlk bağlantı kurma isteğinde zamanlayıcının başlatılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC/RIU ile henüz güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurmamıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: OBU'dan RBC'ye ilk bağlantı kurma isteği gönderilir.
test_cases.assumptions: Zamanlayıcı durumu OBU iç durumlarından veya loglardan gözlemlenebilir.

steps.action: OBU, RBC'ye ilk güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurma isteğini gönderir.
steps.expected: Bağlantı durumu zamanlayıcısı başlatılır.

test_cases.title: Bağlantı sürdürme isteğinde zamanlayıcının başlatılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC/RIU ile güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurmuştur ve oturum devam etmektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Oturumu sürdürmek için yeni bir istek gönderilir.

steps.action: OBU, mevcut oturumu sürdürmek için RBC'ye istek gönderir.
steps.expected: Bağlantı durumu zamanlayıcısı başlatılır.

test_cases.title: Geçerli durum geçişlerinin uygulanması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU 'No Connection' durumunda.
test_cases.test_inputs: Bağlantı kurma isteği gönderilir ve RBC'den yanıt alınır.
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026 Tablo 1 ve 2'de tanımlı geçiş koşulları sağlanmaktadır.

steps.action: Bağlantı kurma isteği gönderilir ve RBC'den başarılı yanıt alınır.
steps.expected: Durum 'No Connection' dan 'Connection Up' a geçer.

test_cases.title: Geçersiz durum geçişinin engellenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU 'No Connection' durumunda.
test_cases.test_inputs: Doğrudan 'Connection Up' durumuna geçiş denemesi (geçerli ara durumlar atlanarak).
test_cases.assumptions: Sistem, SUBSET-026 Tablo 1'de tanımlı geçişleri dışındaki geçişleri reddetmelidir.

steps.action: Geçerli bir bağlantı kurma süreci olmadan 'Connection Up' durumuna geçiş denemesi yapılır.
steps.expected: Durum 'No Connection' olarak kalır, geçersiz geçiş gerçekleşmez.

test_cases.title: Mevcut infill alanına ait RIU bağlantı durumunun gösterilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, birden fazla Radio Infill Unit (RIU) ile güvenli radyo bağlantısına sahiptir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Tren, RIU-A'nın infill alanından RIU-B'nin infill alanına geçer.
test_cases.assumptions: Trenin konumu ve hangi RIU alanında olduğu OBU tarafından doğru olarak belirlenmektedir.

steps.action: Tren RIU-A alanındayken sürücü arayüzü incelenir.
steps.expected: Göstergede RIU-A'ya ait bağlantı durumu görünür.

steps.action: Tren RIU-B alanına geçer.
steps.expected: Göstergede RIU-B'ye ait bağlantı durumu görünür.

test_cases.title: LRBG geçişinde geçerli tren konumunun kabulü
test_cases.preconditions: Tren konumu bilinmiyor veya geçersiz olarak işaretlenmiştir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Tren, LRBG (Linking Reference Balise Group) üzerinden geçer.

steps.action: Tren, LRBG üzerinden geçer.
steps.expected: OBU, araçta saklanan geçerli tren konumunu kabul eder ve konum geçerli olarak işaretlenir.

test_cases.title: ORBG geçişinde geçerli tren konumunun kabulü
test_cases.preconditions: Tren konumu bilinmiyor veya geçersiz olarak işaretlenmiştir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Tren, ORBG (Operational Reference Balise Group) üzerinden geçer.

steps.action: Tren, ORBG üzerinden geçer.
steps.expected: OBU, araçta saklanan geçerli tren konumunu kabul eder ve konum geçerli olarak işaretlenir.

test_cases.title: Geçersiz tren konumunun silinmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Araçta daha önce saklanmış geçersiz bir tren konumu vardır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Tren, LRBG üzerinden geçer.

steps.action: Tren, LRBG üzerinden geçer ve geçerli konum kabul edilir.
steps.expected: Daha önce saklanmış geçersiz tren konumu silinir.

test_cases.title: Aktif kabinin tren yönünü belirlemesi
test_cases.preconditions: Trende birden fazla kabin vardır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Kabin A aktif edilir.

steps.action: Kabin A aktif edilir.
steps.expected: Tren yönü, Kabin A'nın tarafı olarak tanımlanır.

test_cases.title: Aktif kabin yokken son aktif kabinin yönü kullanılması
test_cases.preconditions: Kabin A aktifti, ardından Kabin A pasif hale getirildi ve başka kabin aktif edilmedi.
test_cases.test_inputs: Tüm kabinler pasif.

steps.action: Tüm kabinler pasif hale getirilir.
steps.expected: Tren yönü, son aktif kabin olan Kabin A'nın tarafı olarak tanımlanır.

test_cases.title: Konum tabanlı denetimde tahmini ön uç konumunun kullanılması
test_cases.preconditions: Tren hareket halindedir ve konum tabanlı bir bilgi denetlenmektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trenin tahmini ön uç konumu bilinen bir noktaya ulaşır.
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026'da bu fonksiyon için başka bir referans belirtilmemiştir.

steps.action: Trenin tahmini ön uç konumu, denetlenen konum tabanlı bilginin referans noktasına ulaşır.
steps.expected: OBU, denetim için tahmini ön uç konumunu kullanır.

test_cases.title: End Section zamanlayıcısı için max safe front end referansının kullanılması

test_cases.title: OBU interprets continuous profile data with incremental distances
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in operational mode and has previously received some profile data.
test_cases.test_inputs: A sequence of continuous profile data values: [Value A, Value B, Value C] with distances [100m, 200m, 300m].
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can display or log the applied profile values over distance for verification.

steps.action: Transmit the first value (Value A) with a distance of 100m.
steps.expected: The OBU applies Value A over the first 100m.

steps.action: Transmit the second value (Value B) with a distance of 200m.
steps.expected: The OBU applies Value B over the next 200m (from 100m to 300m).

steps.action: Transmit the third value (Value C) with a distance of 300m.
steps.expected: The OBU applies Value C over the next 300m (from 300m to 600m).

test_cases.title: OBU applies previously received data over the first distance
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has previously received profile data (Value X) which is currently active.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new continuous profile data value (Value Y) with a distance of 150m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can display or log the applied profile values over distance for verification.

steps.action: Transmit the new value (Value Y) with a distance of 150m.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the previously received data (Value X) over the first 150m.

steps.action: Check the profile data application after the first 150m.
steps.expected: The OBU applies Value Y after the first 150m.

test_cases.title: OBU applies last value without limit unless it is end-of-profile
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: A sequence of continuous profile data values: [Value A, Value B] where Value B is not the end-of-profile value.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can display or log the applied profile values over distance for verification.

steps.action: Transmit Value A with a distance of 100m.
steps.expected: The OBU applies Value A over the first 100m.

steps.action: Transmit Value B with a distance of 200m, ensuring Value B is not the end-of-profile value.
steps.expected: The OBU applies Value B over the next 200m and continues to apply Value B indefinitely beyond 300m.

test_cases.title: OBU takes into account a value followed by a zero distance
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: A continuous profile data value (Value Z) followed by a distance of 0m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can display or log the applied profile values over distance for verification.

steps.action: Transmit Value Z with a distance of 0m.
steps.expected: The OBU takes Value Z into account, applying it immediately or as per the specific interpretation of zero distance in the standard.

test_cases.title: OBU interprets location data with unsigned incremental distances

steps.expected: The OBU applies the previously received location data over the first 50m.

steps.action: Transmit Loc B with a distance of 100m.

test_cases.title: OBU handles location data representing a set of data

test_cases.title: OBU interprets non-continuous profile data with incremental distances
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in operational mode and has previously received profile data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Non-continuous profile data elements: [Value A for 100m, Value B for 200m] with start distances [50m, 150m].
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can display or log the applied profile values over distance for verification.

steps.action: Transmit the first element (Value A for 100m) with a start distance of 50m.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the previously received data over the first 50m, then applies Value A for the next 100m (from 50m to 150m).

steps.action: Transmit the second element (Value B for 200m) with a start distance of 150m from the start of the previous element.
steps.expected: The OBU applies Value B starting from 150m (relative to the start of the previous element) for 200m.

test_cases.title: OBU accepts overlapping non-continuous profile data elements
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Non-continuous profile data elements: [Value A for 100m, Value B for 100m] where the start of Value B is within the range of Value A.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can display or log the applied profile values over distance for verification.

steps.action: Transmit the first element (Value A for 100m) with a start distance of 0m.
steps.expected: The OBU applies Value A from 0m to 100m.

steps.action: Transmit the second element (Value B for 100m) with a start distance of 50m from the start of the previous element.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the overlap and applies Value B from 50m to 150m, overriding Value A in the overlapping region (50m to 100m) as per the standard's definition of overlap handling.

test_cases.title: OBU interprets linking information for balise groups

test_cases.title: Remaining distance calculation upon supervision start

test_cases.test_inputs: Start supervision (e.g., enter Full Supervision mode).
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026 §3.6.7.1 distances are configured in the OBU.

steps.action: Start the supervision function.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance to be travelled for each distance listed in SUBSET-026 §3.6.7.1 (e.g., roll-away, reverse movement, standstill, etc.) immediately.

test_cases.title: Remaining distance calculation upon supervision restart
test_cases.preconditions: OBU supervision was active, then stopped (e.g., due to loss of MA). The train is at a specific location.
test_cases.test_inputs: Restart supervision (e.g., receive new MA and enter Full Supervision).

steps.expected: The OBU recalculates the remaining distance to be travelled for each distance listed in SUBSET-026 §3.6.7.1 immediately.

test_cases.title: Supervision of roll-away distance using estimated distance travelled
test_cases.preconditions: Supervision for roll-away distance is active. The train is at the location where supervision started.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train moves forward 100 meters.
test_cases.assumptions: Roll-away distance limit is 500 meters.

steps.action: Move the train forward 100 meters.
steps.expected: The OBU supervises the roll-away distance using the estimated distance travelled (100m) away from the start location. The remaining roll-away distance is 400m.

test_cases.title: Supervision of Staff Responsible distance using virtual train front position
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Staff Responsible mode after Override without valid position. The Staff Responsible distance is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train moves forward 50 meters.
test_cases.assumptions: Odometer under/over-reading correction is applied as per §3.6.7.3.

steps.action: Move the train forward 50 meters.
steps.expected: The OBU supervises a virtual train front position. The remaining distance is derived from the estimated, max safe and min safe front ends, corrected by odometer under/over-reading.

test_cases.title: MA rejection when SSP/gradient does not cover full MA length

test_cases.title: MA acceptance when SSP/gradient covers full MA length
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where it can accept an MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with length 1000m. SSP/gradient data covers 1000m of the MA.

steps.action: Receive an MA where the SSP and gradient data cover the full length of the MA.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the MA.

test_cases.title: Replacement of stored track description information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has stored track description information for a specific track condition type.
test_cases.test_inputs: New track description information for the same type, starting from a location within the existing stored information.

steps.action: Receive new track description information for the same type.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces the stored information of the same type, either completely or from the start location of the new information, following the per-type rules of SUBSET-026 §3.7.3.1.

test_cases.title: Resumption of initial states for PBD speed restrictions
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has stored PBD speed restriction information.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside request to resume initial states for PBD speed restrictions beyond a given location.

steps.action: Receive a trackside request to resume initial states for PBD speed restrictions beyond a given location.
steps.expected: The OBU resumes initial states beyond the given location for the stored PBD speed restriction information.

test_cases.title: Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation with matching direction
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where it can accept a Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation. The current train orientation is forward.
test_cases.test_inputs: Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation with validity direction forward.

test_cases.title: Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation with opposite direction

test_cases.title: MA request includes all applicable reasons
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 and connected to RBC. Multiple MA request conditions are active simultaneously (e.g., Section timer expired and track description deletion).
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulate conditions that trigger multiple MA request reasons defined in SUBSET-026 §3.8.2.1.1.
test_cases.assumptions: The RBC or a test tool can capture and decode the MA request message to verify the content of the 'MA request reasons' field.

steps.action: Trigger a condition that generates a specific MA request reason (e.g., Section timer expiry).
steps.expected: OBU prepares an MA request.

steps.action: Trigger a second condition that generates a different MA request reason before the request is sent.
steps.expected: OBU updates the pending MA request context to include the new reason.

steps.action: Allow the OBU to send the MA request to the RBC.
steps.expected: The sent MA request message contains both the first and the second MA request reason in the appropriate field.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered by perturbation-location criterion

steps.expected: No MA request is sent to the RBC.

steps.action: Move the train front so that it passes the location resulting from the perturbation-location criterion.
steps.expected: The OBU triggers and sends an MA request to the RBC.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered by Section timer/LOA speed timer criterion
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. The Section timer or LOA speed timer is running. The timer value is approaching the threshold defined by the criterion.
test_cases.test_inputs: Time progression to reach the timer threshold.
test_cases.assumptions: The Section timer/LOA speed timer criterion is configured in the test environment according to SUBSET-026 §3.8.2.2.1.

steps.action: Allow the Section timer/LOA speed timer to run until just before the moment resulting from the criterion is reached.
steps.expected: No MA request is sent to the RBC.

steps.action: Allow the timer to reach the moment resulting from the Section timer/LOA speed timer criterion.
steps.expected: The OBU triggers and sends an MA request to the RBC.

steps.expected: The OBU detects the deletion.

steps.expected: The OBU sends an MA request to the RBC.

test_cases.title: No MA request on track description deletion (excluded situation a)

test_cases.test_inputs: RBC message or internal event causing deletion of the track description part under situation 'a'.

test_cases.title: End Section timer start upon passing start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. Trackside has sent a valid End Section timer start location and a finite time-out value. The train is approaching the start location.
test_cases.test_inputs: End Section timer start location: 1000m from current position. Time-out value: 10s.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a debug interface or log to observe the internal timer state.

steps.action: Move the train such that the max safe front end is just before the End Section timer start location.
steps.expected: The End Section timer is not started (state: stopped or 0).

steps.action: Move the train such that the max safe front end passes the End Section timer start location.
steps.expected: The End Section timer starts counting.

test_cases.title: EOA/LOA withdrawal upon End Section timer expiry
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. End Section timer is running. The current MA includes a LOA with a non-zero target speed at the end. The train is moving within the MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: End Section timer time-out: 5s. Current train position: 500m. LOA end position: 1000m. Target speed at LOA end: 80 km/h.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows observation of the MA status, target speed, and location-based information.

steps.action: Wait for the End Section timer to exceed the 5s time-out value.
steps.expected: The OBU withdraws the EOA/LOA to the train's current position (500m).

steps.action: Check the location-based information listed in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4.
steps.expected: The relevant location-based information is deleted.

steps.action: Check the target speed at the End of Movement Authority.
steps.expected: The target speed is set to zero.

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer start in Level 2
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A new MA message is received from trackside containing a LOA.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA message timestamp: T0. LOA speed timer time-out: 10s.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a debug interface to observe the LOA speed timer start time.

steps.action: Receive the MA message at time T0.
steps.expected: The LOA speed timer starts at time T0.

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer start in Level 1
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1. The train is approaching a balise group that provides the MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group location: 200m ahead. LOA speed timer time-out: 10s.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a debug interface to observe the LOA speed timer start time.

steps.action: Move the train to pass the first balise of the balise group giving the MA.
steps.expected: The LOA speed timer starts at the moment of passing the first balise.

test_cases.title: LOA conversion to EOA upon LOA speed timer expiry
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. LOA speed timer is running. The current MA includes a LOA with a non-zero speed. The train is moving within the LOA.
test_cases.test_inputs: LOA speed timer time-out: 5s. LOA speed: 100 km/h. Train position: 300m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows observation of the MA type, speed, and location-based information.

steps.action: Wait for the LOA speed timer to exceed the 5s time-out value.
steps.expected: The speed associated with the LOA is set to zero.

steps.action: Check the MA type.
steps.expected: The LOA becomes an EOA with the Supervised Location defined per SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.5.

steps.action: Check the location-based information listed in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4.
steps.expected: The relevant location-based information is deleted.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer start upon passing start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. Trackside has sent a valid Overlap timer start location and a finite time-out value. The train is approaching the start location.

steps.action: Move the train such that the max safe front end passes the Overlap timer start location.
steps.expected: The Overlap timer starts counting.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer start with infinite time-out
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. Trackside has sent a valid Overlap timer start location and a time-out value of 'infinite'. The train is approaching the start location.

test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a debug interface or log to observe the internal timer state.

steps.action: Move the train such that the max safe front end passes the Overlap timer start location.
steps.expected: The Overlap timer is regarded as started.

test_cases.title: Overlap deletion and MA update upon Overlap timer expiry
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. Overlap timer is running. The current MA includes an overlap with a release speed. The train is moving within the MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: Overlap timer time-out: 10s. Overlap release speed: 50 km/h. Train position: 800m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows observation of the MA status, overlap information, and target speed.

steps.action: Check the Supervised Location.

steps.action: Check the target speed at the End of Movement Authority.
steps.expected: Any non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority is set to zero.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer started and train comes to standstill
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. An MA with an Overlap timer is active. The Overlap timer has been started but has not yet timed out.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed reduced to 0 km/h.
test_cases.assumptions: The consequences of Overlap time-out (e.g., braking to stop) are observable via OBU status or brake application.

steps.action: Ensure the Overlap timer is running and the train is moving.
steps.expected: OBU is in Full Supervision, Overlap timer is active.

steps.action: Bring the train to a complete standstill (0 km/h).
steps.expected: OBU treats the Overlap timer as expired.

steps.action: Observe OBU behavior.
steps.expected: OBU applies the consequences defined for Overlap time-out (e.g., initiates braking or changes supervision state).

test_cases.title: New MA with Overlap start location behind max safe front end

steps.expected: OBU status indicates no active Overlap timer.

steps.action: Inject a new MA where the Overlap timer start location is behind the max safe front end.
steps.expected: OBU receives the new MA.

steps.action: Observe OBU behavior.
steps.expected: OBU considers the Overlap timer to have exceeded its time-out value and applies SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.4.2 consequences.

test_cases.title: Supervised Location is end of overlap

steps.action: Load an MA with an Overlap section that has not timed out.

steps.action: Check the Supervised Location value.

test_cases.title: Supervised Location is Danger Point when Overlap timed out

test_cases.title: Supervised Location is end of End Section when no Overlap or Danger Point

test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside route suitability data with a traction system not accepted by the engine.
test_cases.assumptions: The traction system received from trackside is not among those accepted by the engine.

steps.action: Trackside sends route suitability data with a traction system not accepted by the engine.
steps.expected: OBU receives the route suitability data.

steps.action: OBU compares the route suitability data with the stored Train Data.
steps.expected: OBU detects an unsuitability due to traction system.

steps.action: Check the OBU status.
steps.expected: The OBU indicates a route suitability unsuitability.

test_cases.title: No traction system unsuitability if engine can run without traction
test_cases.preconditions: Train Data indicates that the engine can run on a line without any traction system. Trackside sends route suitability data with a traction system not accepted by the engine.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside route suitability data with a traction system not accepted by the engine.
test_cases.assumptions: The engine is capable of running without traction.

steps.action: Trackside sends route suitability data with a traction system not accepted by the engine.
steps.expected: OBU receives the route suitability data.

steps.action: OBU compares the route suitability data with the stored Train Data.
steps.expected: OBU does not detect a traction system unsuitability because the engine can run without traction.

steps.action: Check the OBU status.
steps.expected: The OBU does not indicate a traction system unsuitability.

test_cases.title: No route suitability data allows train to run
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where route suitability is supervised. No route suitability data is given by trackside.
test_cases.test_inputs: No route suitability data from trackside.

steps.action: Ensure no route suitability data is sent by trackside.
steps.expected: OBU does not receive any route suitability data.

steps.action: Check the OBU status regarding route suitability.
steps.expected: The OBU allows the train to run.

steps.action: Verify that no default route suitability values are used or supervised.
steps.expected: The OBU does not use or supervise any default route suitability values.

test_cases.title: Display appearance for auxiliary information without acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where text messages are displayed. A trackside text message is configured with class 'auxiliary information' and 'driver acknowledgement not requested'.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message: Class=Auxiliary, Ack=No

steps.action: Send the trackside text message to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU displays the message with the appearance defined for auxiliary information (e.g., specific color or font) and does not prompt for driver acknowledgement.

test_cases.title: Display appearance for important information with acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where text messages are displayed. A trackside text message is configured with class 'important information' and 'driver acknowledgement requested'.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message: Class=Important, Ack=Yes

steps.action: Send the trackside text message to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU displays the message with the appearance defined for important information and prompts the driver for acknowledgement.

test_cases.title: Start condition with multiple sub-conditions (OR logic)
test_cases.preconditions: A trackside text message defines two start sub-conditions: 'Speed > 100 km/h' and 'Location > 1000m'. The trackside definition specifies that the condition is fulfilled if 'either one' is met.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed: 110 km/h, Location: 500m

steps.action: Set train speed to 110 km/h and location to 500m.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the start condition fulfilled because one of the sub-conditions (Speed > 100 km/h) is met.

test_cases.title: Start condition with multiple sub-conditions (AND logic)
test_cases.preconditions: A trackside text message defines two start sub-conditions: 'Speed > 100 km/h' and 'Location > 1000m'. The trackside definition specifies that the condition is fulfilled if 'all' are met.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed: 110 km/h, Location: 500m

steps.action: Set train speed to 110 km/h and location to 500m.
steps.expected: The OBU does not consider the start condition fulfilled because not all sub-conditions are met (Location is not > 1000m).

steps.action: Move train to location 1100m while maintaining speed 110 km/h.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the start condition fulfilled because all sub-conditions are now met.

test_cases.title: Start condition fulfilled immediately when no sub-conditions defined
test_cases.preconditions: A trackside text message is received that defines none of the start sub-conditions listed in SUBSET-026 §3.12.3.4.2.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message with empty start condition list

steps.action: Receive the text message.
steps.expected: The OBU treats the start condition as fulfilled immediately upon receipt.

test_cases.title: Driver acknowledgement ends display regardless of end condition
test_cases.preconditions: A text message requesting driver confirmation is displayed. The message defines that acknowledgement always ends the display. The end condition (e.g., location) is not yet fulfilled.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message: Ack=Yes, Ack_Ends_Display=Always

steps.action: Driver acknowledges the message.
steps.expected: The OBU stops displaying the message immediately, even though the end condition is not fulfilled.

test_cases.title: Driver acknowledgement is necessary but not sufficient to end display
test_cases.preconditions: A text message requesting driver confirmation is displayed. The message defines that acknowledgement is a necessary condition in addition to the end condition. The end condition (e.g., location) is not yet fulfilled.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message: Ack=Yes, Ack_Ends_Display=Necessary

steps.action: Driver acknowledges the message.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to display the message because the end condition is not yet fulfilled.

steps.action: Fulfill the end condition (e.g., pass the location).
steps.expected: The OBU stops displaying the message.

test_cases.title: Message not displayed if end condition already fulfilled at start
test_cases.preconditions: A text message is received. The start condition is fulfilled. The end condition is already fulfilled at the moment the start condition is fulfilled.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message with start and end conditions both met at receipt

steps.action: Receive the text message with start and end conditions already met.
steps.expected: The OBU does not display the message at all.

test_cases.title: Display length measured from start location
test_cases.preconditions: A text message uses the location sub-condition for its end condition. The start condition includes a location sub-condition at 1000m and another sub-condition (e.g., speed) that is met at 1000m.
test_cases.test_inputs: Start Location: 1000m, End Location: 1500m

steps.action: Train passes 1000m, fulfilling the start condition.
steps.expected: The OBU starts displaying the message.

steps.action: Train moves to 1500m.
steps.expected: The OBU stops displaying the message, having measured the display length from the start location (1000m) to the end location (1500m).

test_cases.title: Send driver acknowledgement report to RBC

test_cases.title: Reject new message with same ID as unacknowledged message

steps.action: Receive a new text message with ID 123 requesting a report of driver acknowledgement.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the new text message.

test_cases.title: Temporary EOA at Mode Profile start when profile requires SvL

steps.expected: The OBU treats the LOA as a temporary EOA and considers a temporary SvL without release speed at the LOA, as if no LOA were given.

test_cases.title: LX information replacement with same identity

test_cases.title: LX information retention with different identity

steps.action: Verify the stored LX information for Identity ID 'ID-2'.

test_cases.title: Blocklist comparison applies to the entire password, not substrings
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative is in the password creation flow. The blocklist contains the word 'password'.
test_cases.test_inputs: Password: 'mypasswordisstrong' (contains 'password' as a substring).
test_cases.assumptions: The blocklist contains the exact string 'password' but not 'mypasswordisstrong'. The system compares the entire prospective password against the blocklist entries.

steps.action: Enter the password 'mypasswordisstrong'.
steps.expected: The system does not reject the password based on the substring 'password' if the blocklist check is for exact matches of the whole password or if the blocklist entry is 'password' and the check is not substring-based. *Correction*: NIST says 'compare the prospective password against a blocklist'. Usually, this means exact match or fuzzy match. If the blocklist has 'password', and the user enters 'mypasswordisstrong', does it match? The requirement KDH-032 says 'subject the entire prospective password to the blocklist comparison, not substrings'. This implies if the blocklist has 'password', and the user enters 'mypasswordisstrong', it should NOT be rejected just because it contains 'password', unless the blocklist logic is fuzzy. However, standard blocklists often contain full phrases. Let's assume the blocklist contains 'password' as a standalone entry. If the system checks if the *entire* password is in the blocklist, 'mypasswordisstrong' is not in the blocklist. If the system checks if any *substring* is in the blocklist, it would be rejected. The requirement says 'not substrings'. So, if the blocklist has 'password', and the user enters 'mypasswordisstrong', it should be accepted (assuming length is OK).

steps.action: Submit the password.
steps.expected: The password is accepted, demonstrating that the presence of a blocked substring does not trigger rejection if the entire password is not in the blocklist.

test_cases.title: Authentication generates a new session token and invalidates the previous one

steps.action: User attempts to make a request using the old session token (Token A).
steps.expected: Request is rejected with an unauthorized or invalid session error.

steps.action: User makes a request using the new session token (Token B).
steps.expected: Request is processed successfully.

steps.action: User attempts to make a request using the previously valid session token.
steps.expected: Request is rejected with an unauthorized or invalid session error, confirming backend invalidation.

test_cases.title: Session expiration invalidates session data at the backend

steps.expected: Session status is marked as expired.

steps.action: User attempts to make a request using the expired session token.
steps.expected: Request is rejected with an unauthorized or invalid session error, confirming backend invalidation.

test_cases.title: Access to another user's data is denied when identifier is changed
test_cases.preconditions: User A is authenticated and has permission to access their own application/document. User B has a different application/document with a known identifier.

steps.expected: Request is successful and the document is returned.

steps.action: User A modifies the request to use User B's document identifier instead of their own.
steps.expected: Request is rejected with an access denied or unauthorized error.

test_cases.title: Access to unauthorized data item is denied
